claim_boundaries.conversion: PASS means both official converter directions emitted parseable artifacts; warnings and dropped constructs may still exist.
claim_boundaries.numerical: PASS requires actual target-generated/executed queries matching the independent oracle; BLOCKED means prerequisites or target initialization prevent comparison.
claim_boundaries.outbound_numerical: Ossie is an interchange artifact, so individual source-to-Ossie legs have no numerical execution; NOT_EXECUTED is deliberate.
claim_boundaries.semantic: PASS is bounded to inspected declarative-definition preservation, not execution. MISMATCH records concrete contract/configuration loss. UNKNOWN means insufficient evidence.

returned_model_relation.alias:

       o.order_id, o.order_date, o.amount_eur, o.order_status
FROM demo.semantic_interop.sessions AS s
LEFT JOIN demo.semantic_interop.orders AS o
  ON s.session_id = o.session_id
 AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-03-01'
WHERE s.session_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.session_date < DATE '2026-03-01'

       o.order_id, o.order_date, o.amount_eur, o.order_status
FROM demo.semantic_interop.sessions AS s
LEFT JOIN demo.semantic_interop.orders AS o
  ON s.session_id = o.session_id
 AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-03-01'
